hero.title: Your fund check is done. Now get more out of it.
hero.description: On KassenBoost you compared what your fund can do, on contributions and bonuses, neutrally. Healio is the brokerage behind it. If you want, we translate your bonus potential into real supplementary cover. Free and without obligation.
hero.secondaryCta: Not compared yet? To the KassenBoost check
hero.externalNote: The comparison runs on KassenBoost's own website. Your entries stay there and are never transferred to Healio automatically.

privacy.title: No hidden data bridge.
privacy.confirmation: Nothing from your KassenBoost comparison was transferred to Healio. You decide what to share in a call.
details: No health fund and no comparison result
No region, no income and no personal preferences
No health details and no decision for or against an offer

bonus.title: Take the cash. Or triple it into cover.
bonus.description: Many funds reward prevention and sport twice over: you can take your bonus as cash, or as an earmarked subsidy at triple the amount, for example towards the annual premium of a private supplementary policy. This is exactly where Healio comes in.
bonus.exampleLabel: Verified example, IKK classic, bonus year 2026
bonus.example: Every regular activity such as gym or sports club earns 25 EUR in cash there, or counts triple as a 75 EUR subsidy. Private supplementary insurance is explicitly listed as an eligible subsidy item, and the terms state: there is no maximum amount.
bonus.note: Amounts and conditions depend on the fund and bonus year. Subsidy payouts never exceed your proven costs. We check together what applies to your fund.

protection.eyebrow: What the bonus is good for
protection.title: Cover that fits you.
protection.description: Combined with fund bonuses, a health budget of up to 3,000 EUR in 2 years can build up step by step, depending on fund, tariff and the services you actually use. Healio independently explains three areas of cover.

items.title: Outpatient
items.description: More room for naturopathy, osteopathy, glasses or extra prevention, depending on the chosen tariff.

items.title: Dental
items.description: Make out-of-pocket costs for treatment and dentures more plannable and understand conditions before signing.

items.title: Hospital
items.description: More choice of doctor, clinic and room, if that freedom matters to you.

termin.title: Talk to us about your result.
termin.description: Pick a slot: 30 minutes, phone or video call. Bring your KassenBoost result and we will run the numbers on which path pays off for you.
transparency: Advice and brokerage are free for you. If you sign a policy, the insurer pays Healio a commission.
The KassenBoost comparison stays separate. No ranking there is influenced by commission.
You decide freely. No call obliges you to anything.

employer.title: Access for employees. No insight for the employer.
employer.description: Employers can offer KassenBoost voluntarily as orientation. Individual entries, results and decisions stay private. Healio designs company benefits separately from that.
